Subject: Orion batch decline: multiple invoices failing - need help

Hi Hannah,

Quick note — over the past 6 hours we've seen ~12 charge failures on our Stripe account that used to succeed. The failures look like acquirer declines (some 3DS/issuer flags) and one charge has already been disputed by the cardholder (invoice 789). Our finance team is seeing this impacting today's settlement.

Can Redwood: 1) confirm whether you see a spike in declines on our merchant profile? 2) help us trigger a partial refund for disputed invoice 789 while we gather evidence? We want to avoid an immediate chargeback if possible and we're willing to accept a partial refund while we reconcile.

I've attached a screenshot from the Stripe dashboard with the decline codes and included the two affected charge IDs below: ch_1JQftK2x... and ch_1JQftL9y...

Attachments: stripe_charge_2027-10-07.png, invoice_789.pdf

Thanks — please loop in whoever needs to be involved.

Thanks Laura — and sorry you're running into this. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) We're seeing a short-lived spike in declines routed through one of the EU PSP partners tied to your account. The pattern matches an acquirer-side authorization hold that started ~14:30Z.
2) We can issue a partial refund on invoice 789 immediately if you authorize it. To process we need: last 4 of the card (**** 4242), the Stripe charge IDs you mentioned (full values preferred), and confirmation that Orion accepts a partial refund instead of fighting the dispute now.

Proposed timeline:
- You confirm partial-refund amount and provide the full charge IDs (by reply).
- We create a refund request from Redwood's finance workflow (expected visibility within 1 business hour after request).
- Simultaneously we'll open a merchant support ticket with our PSP to understand why these specific auths were flagged and request temporary routing fallback to the alternate PSP while we investigate.

If you want us to hold off on refunds and instead submit dispute evidence, say so — but note that could take 7–14 days and risks an immediate chargeback depending on the issuing bank.

What I need from you to proceed now:
- Confirm partial refund amount (we recommend 60% for invoice 789 as a good-will split)
- Full Stripe charge IDs (not truncated)
- Last 4 of card or customer reference so we can tie it to the invoice

Once you reply I'll route to Sean for PSP fallback and to our billing queue to process the refund.

— Hannah Schmitt
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
